Two later original unsealed observations are distinct from this preparation. At `2026-10-08T00:24:14.484190Z` (2026-10-07 20:24 ET), the parent observed six exact source/empty-retention mode/stat/SHA rows; this was metadata only. At `2026-10-08T00:30:07.892710Z` (2026-10-07 20:30 ET), the parent separately corrected **only** the delivered ee12a source at primary revision `742aa576f69df2d2c70047a7acf49fafbe8a9abf`, physical0666→0644. Its exact producer is included; this archive neither repeats that administration nor treats it as correction-main, export, reader or science success. Active R14 and raw scientific files were unchanged by that source-only administration.

## Pending production gates

All six invoker mains, production928/690/ee12a mains, the completed21-file correction, export and selected-reader admission remain pending. Genuine all-nine completion, original sealed acceptance/request, final validation and cleanup/released leases, exact completed correction receipt/stat pins, actual report and directory size/modes, delivered revision, source/native/wrapper pins, fresh paths and full actual public argv are required at future invocation; no value is manufactured here. Original True scientific-input policies and False supervisor-receipt policy remain distinct from unsealed administrative observations.

The nominal total is `2D+18300` (25500s at D=3600), plus separately reviewed enclosing/bootstrap/publication/transport margin. This is source-defined accounting, not measured duration or a claim that18300s covers the full invocation.
